messages:
kumar: seeing a ~12% capacity drop across us-west1 + eu-west1 starting ~08:20 UTC, high ECC counts and Xid timeouts. routing heatmap shows burst to canary-quant nodes.

maria: yikes. is this correlated with the probe rollout from last night?

kumar: yes, the probe agent v2.4.1 rolled at 03:00. telemetry shows a spike in probe-fail -> soft ECC increments after that.

lee: slack summary from prometheus: `gpu_ecc_errors_total{region=~"us-west1|eu-west1"}` jumped from ~200/day to ~8k/hour around 08:15.

ajohnson: any CVs on NVMe/controller flaps? or just ECC counters on the card?

kumar: primarily CE (corrected ECC) counters on the card, Xid 13/46 seen on some hosts. no obvious nics or psu alerts.

maria: can you paste the probe config that was deployed? maybe a sampling rate change blew up the prober and caused noise.

kumar: config snippet: ```yml
probe:
  sampling_interval_ms: 10
  stress_check: true
  kernel_module: nv_gpu_probe_v2
```

lee: sampling 10ms is aggressive — we usually run 100ms. that could push more mem accesses and surface soft ECCs.

ajohnson: agree. if the probe is poking registers that trigger parity checks, we'll see CE inflation. recommendation: flip sampling back to 100ms and revert kernel_module to nv_gpu_probe_v1.

maria: we should avoid mass drains; prefer a targeted mitigation: 1) reduce probe sampling 2) throttle canaries to reserved pool 3) enable automatic fallback routing for affected regions.

dana: on it. I'll submit a small rollback to infra-config: set sampling_interval_ms=100 and kernel_module=nv_gpu_probe_v1.

sre-bot: deploy started: infra-config rollback (change #4237) -> 6 hosts per region first, 30s intervals.

kumar: also enabling routing fallback: route policy 'ecc-surrogate' to route low-priority workloads to dedicated-fallback cluster in us-central.

lee: runbook check: avoid simultaneous drains in the same rack. we're only toggling probe; no drains yet.

ajohnson: can we add a quick KV-cache bypass to reduce memory churn on affected models? small config patch would reduce active tokenism on those GPUs.

maria: good idea. pushing model-routing patch to bypass caching for experimental models in affected regions.

sre-bot: deploy completed: infra-config rollback rolled to 6/6 hosts in us-west1 and 6/6 in eu-west1.

kumar: telemetry after 3 minutes: ECC counters trending down ~65% in rolled hosts. capacity reclaiming slowly.

lee: check Xid rate: `count_over_time(gpu_xid_errors[5m])` dropped from 120 to 8 in rolled hosts.

dana: continuing gradual rollout to remaining hosts, 20s intervals. will hold if we see regressions.

maria: ops note: file a postmortem link once stable. include lesson: avoid aggressive probe sampling without staged perf testing.

ajohnson: also recommend adding a synthetic workload test for probe changes to catch CE inflation in CI.

kumar: thanks all — keeping this thread for followups. I'll update once full rollout completes and capacity back to baseline. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: alert cleared for region eu-west1 (partial), ongoing for us-west1 (rolling).
